evidence: STRUCTURE (no defect found). tests/scoring.toml: gates render=0.0, constraints=0.0; weights functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2; floors functional=0.05. tests/tools/score.py:46-48 computes reward = weighted mean of the three dimension scores when gates pass and floors pass, so reward is continuous, not all-or-nothing. Gates are each ONE binary criterion with low bars: render (gates/render/judge.toml hro_gate_render: wrong password refused, right password shows a usable staff workspace) and constraints (gates/constraints/judge.toml hro_gate_shared: open a job + add one candidate, seen from an independent Observer context). These exclude dead/static/browser-only apps but any real partial app clears them; stage rules, conversations and live updates are explicitly kept out of the gates. Functional: 43 binary criteria aggregated weighted_mean, total weight 58.5; heaviest single criterion 2.5 (4.3%), lightest 0.5 (0.85%) - no criterion dominates. Floor 0.05 is cleared by ~3 typical criteria (weight >2.925), so it stops a non-working app farming polish/visual without collapsing partial apps. functional/prompt.md:13 'score EACH criterion independently, continue after failures and keep successful observations. A failed sibling verdict is not evidence against another row... When a setup step fails, set up the same thing again on a new job of your own' and :23 'Never deduct one observed defect in more than one row' directly counter the 'all criteria depend on one precondition' failure mode named in quality-checks.md #40. Criteria are spread over independent feature areas (intake/S, moves/M, places/L, concurrency/C, bulk+undo/B, roles/R, notes/N, conversations/T, unread/seen/U, candidate view/K, activity/A, live/V, restart/D), and T has an explicit fallback to the seeded conversation if hro_candidate_linked fails. Polish: 5 binary criteria weights 3/3/2/1.5/2.5 (weighted_mean) on distinct behaviours. Visual: 5 likert(5) criteria with anchors at every level, giving fine-grained gradation. The only shared precondition inside scored dims is the in-dimension browser gate (functional/prompt.md:11-13, polish/prompt.md:11-12, visual/prompt.md:11-12), which mirrors the constraints gate and so is already satisfied by any app that reached the scored suite. THOUGHT EXPERIMENTS: (a) board-only app (jobs, cards, stage moves, roles, persistence; no conversations/live push): passes gates, earns most M/L/B/R/S/A/D functional weight, ~0 on T/U/K-thread and live rows, polish ~2.5/12 at most, visual graded on likert -> mid reward, distinct from golden and from dead apps. (b) full app lacking live push: loses hro_live_board, hro_msg_exchange live leg, hro_unread_counts, hro_seen, hro_stale_refused live leg, and polish live rows (6/12) -> clearly lower but non-zero. (c) dead/static app: zeroed by gates. Ordering is graded rather than binary. Plausible broken app that could pass: none found that farms reward without real persistence, given gates + floor. Conforming alternative that could fail: a correct app whose functional judge exhausts its 9000s budget partway through the long ordered protocol (Z..D) would have later rows forced to binary0 'NOT EXERCISED - evaluator/tool limitation' (functional/prompt.md:53), compressing the spread for reasons unrelated to app quality; similarly any evaluator failure at the in-dimension gate zeros the whole dimension. This is a measurement risk, not a demonstrated rubric defect. MEASUREMENT GAP: raw-evidence-index.json scope states verbatim 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent.' The six indexed artifacts (hashes re-verified matching) are scripted golden browser/API observations only - a single high-quality app, so they cannot show a spread. No mutated weak-app or partial-app reward runs exist. Per SKILL.md 'Never upgrade an unmeasured claim to Pass' and REVIEW_POLICY.md 'Runtime and model evidence' (separate hash-bound reward-discrimination record required; missing evidence remains a gap), the row cannot be cleared as Pass: structure is sound but discrimination is unmeasured.
